watch_out: Free has 10,000 inbound events/month, three sources, nine destinations and 14-day retention, without a signup card. Rate limit is 120 incoming events/minute/source; a 20% buffer avoids immediate paid overage. Higher-volume production features, ordered delivery, static egress IP and DPA need a paid plan.
